items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Talbot Moran' in the context of the George Lewis band; Interviewee does not confirm personal interaction or relationship with Talbot Moran specifically, only acknowledging the band context.

ctx.x: One I remember for sure, and it was, it was a particularly exciting one, because somehow he got part of the George Lewis band there, uh, I think Herb Moran was there, too. Uh-huh. And you were there, don't you remember, wasn't Herb there?
Well, uh, if it's the one I'm thinking about, uh, you know, of course I can't place it, both Talbot and Moran were there, full George Lewis band, Talbot Moran, Burbank, and Bob Matthews.
Why, why Bob Matthews? Why do you include Bob Matthews?
